name: How should I prepare my home before a trim carpenter installs window casing?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before a trim carpenter installs window casing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear away window treatments, blinds, curtain rods, and brackets prior to the crew's arrival. Move furniture at least three to four feet away from each window wall to give carpenters space to position ladders, levels, and nail guns. You should also decide in advance whether you want painted trim or natural stained wood, and whether you want a full picture-frame casing (mitered on all four sides) or a traditional sill and apron assembly, as these choices change the necessary trim materials and labor steps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remove blinds, curtains, and hardware, move furniture 3 to 4 feet away from windows, and confirm your preferred casing style and finish beforehand.
